status: Created after the authorized one-way final-test opening, after the results were locked and independently verified. It changes no scientific artifact, no model, no prediction and no metric.
approved_by: human review, after the locked final test was opened, predicted, locked, scored and independently verified
reason: Phase-3 contains a historical final-test seal gate whose assertion is intentionally false after the authorized Phase-8 one-way final-test opening.
decision: Preserve the historical validator unchanged and validate the post-opening state using a separate phase-aware validator.

detail.gate: No test prediction or test metric artifact exists
detail.gate_scope: results/validation/predictions, results/validation, results/models/b3 and artifacts, scanned recursively for any filename matching 'test', excluding only 'latest' and 'pretest'
detail.why_the_triggers_are_legitimate: The opening receipt is the artifact that authorizes the one-way transition, and is mandated by the locked Phase-8 protocol. Its presence is evidence that the transition occurred under authorization. The metrics artifact is the frozen confirmatory result record. Renaming either to obtain a green validator would be evading a seal tripwire rather than satisfying it.
detail.cascade: validate_phase4 through validate_phase7 nest validate_phase3 and therefore also return non-zero. No gate owned by Phase 4, 5, 6 or 7 fails.
detail.why_this_was_not_visible_before_opening: The opening receipt is written immediately before Stage A, so the gate could not fire until the moment the test was legitimately opened. Any conforming Phase-8 execution reaches the same state.

resolution.new_validator_purpose: Validate the repository after the authorized one-way transition without pretending the historical pre-test seal still exists.
resolution.phase_0_to_2_requirement: PASS outright with existing gate counts 24 / 31 / 58
resolution.phase_3_requirement: exactly one failing gate, the historical seal gate, triggered by exactly the two authorized Phase-8 artifacts and nothing else
resolution.phase_4_to_7_requirement: no independently owned gate failure; the only tolerated failures are the nested Phase-3 seal cascade
resolution.phase_8_requirement: every non-upstream gate of the pre-opening-frozen validator still passes, and the confirmatory values reconcile independently against the frozen result artifacts
